name: typescript-strict
description: Trigger: writing or reviewing TypeScript, defining types or schemas, choosing type versus interface, branding identifiers or amounts, tightening tsconfig. Applies strict-mode boundary typing, single-owner value sets, and validating constructors.
abstract: Adapted from citypaul's typescript-strict skill: untrusted boundaries typed as unknown, assertion discipline, type versus interface semantics, one owner per value set, branded primitives, schema-first trust boundaries, and deliberate strict-mode compiler configuration.
